atlas_fit.current_problem: Atlas needs a safe way to discover reusable agent skills without trusting registry popularity or loading unreviewed instructions.
atlas_fit.future_risk: Skill metadata and bundled files can manipulate discovery, selection, permissions, and tool execution.

claims.claim: Public skill ecosystems provide reusable instruction packages and source-grounded examples across many domains.
Registry rankings or a single scanner are sufficient evidence that a skill is safe.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence

unresolved: Runtime behavior, security effectiveness, performance, and compatibility were not independently executed or benchmarked in this Mission.
Composite source-set claims depend on the cited official pages and require re-Harvest when those pages or terms change.
